parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘electro-convulsive therapy’ (ECT) as a treatment for schizophrenia.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The study by Freeman (2008) used virtual reality to assess symptoms of schizophrenia.
Describe the procedure of this study.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the reliability of this procedure.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the treatment and management of impulse control disorders and non-substance
addictive disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of impulse control disorders and non-substance
addictive disorder, including a discussion of the application of psychology to everyday life.

Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘cognitive map’ in relation to retail environments.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the self-report used in the study by Machleit et al. (2000) on crowding in retail
environments.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one strength and one weakness of self-reports, using the Machleit et al. study as an
example.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about types of advertising and advertising
techniques.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about types of advertising and advertising
techniques, including a discussion on the use of children in psychological research. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how a biochemical test can be used to measure non-adherence to medical advice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe two guidelines given by Ley (1988) for improving practitioner style that should
improve adherence to medical advice.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the guidelines given by Ley (1988).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about the management of stress.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about the management of stress, including a
discussion about ethics. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline one type of job absenteeism.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the Minnesota satisfaction questionnaire (Weiss et al., 1967).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the Minnesota satisfaction questionnaire
and one other questionnaire used to measure job satisfaction.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about motivators at work (e.g. intrinsic and
extrinsic motivation, rewards).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about motivators at work, including a discussion
of reductionism.
